novel_features.name: Local corpus index
novel_features.description: Mirror icon sets and their icon names into local SQLite for offline search and analysis; --only scopes it to specific sets.
novel_features.rationale: The API returns collections as one object and icon names only per-prefix, so no generated sync path can build a queryable corpus; this fans out and stores it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this once before set-pick, swap, audit, or shadcn; it is what makes them answerable without the network.

novel_features.name: Set coverage picker
novel_features.description: Given the icon concepts you need, rank icon sets by how many of them each set actually covers.
novel_features.rationale: Requires one local FTS5 query per concept grouped by prefix; no endpoint returns coverage-by-set.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before writing any UI that needs several icons, so every icon comes from one set at one stroke weight.

novel_features.name: shadcn.io registry bridge
novel_features.description: Turn Iconify icon names into shadcn.io registry slugs and optionally run the install.
novel_features.rationale: The Iconify API knows nothing about shadcn.io; the mapping only works with a local existence and alias check.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the project installs components from shadcn.io and you need the icon as a registry item rather than a raw SVG.

novel_features.name: Manifest-driven icon kit
novel_features.description: Render a whole directory of recoloured, uniformly sized SVGs from a manifest of icon names.
novel_features.rationale: Batches the SVG endpoint's render parameters across a manifest with idempotent writes and a miss report; surveyed tools fetch one icon at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when a deck, brand kit, or design system needs many icons at one colour and size rather than one ad-hoc icon.

novel_features.name: Repo icon audit
novel_features.description: Scan a codebase for Iconify references and report set spread, grid-height mismatches, palette mixing, and dead names.
novel_features.rationale: Joins repository source against the local icons and collections tables; no endpoint reads a filesystem.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this on review to catch icons drifting across sets, or names that silently resolved through an alias.

novel_features.name: Set drift diff
novel_features.description: Show which icons an upstream set added, removed, or aliased since your last sync.
novel_features.rationale: Uses the last-modified cursor to fetch only advanced sets, then diffs against a stored local snapshot; elsewhere last-modified is a raw timestamp with no changeset semantics.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before upgrading an icon dependency, to see whether a name you rely on disappeared.

novel_features.name: Cross-set migration map
novel_features.description: Map a list of icons from one set to another, classifying each as covered, renamed, or missing.
novel_features.rationale: Self-joins the local icons table across two prefixes over canonical names and aliases; no surveyed tool exposes cross-set queries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when standardising an existing codebase onto one icon set, to see the cost before committing.

narrative.headline: Every Iconify icon from one Go binary, plus a local index that answers set-coverage, migration, and audit questions no icon tool answers today.
narrative.value_prop: Search 236 icon sets and roughly 294,000 icons, fetch any icon as a recoloured SVG, and generate CSS or bulk JSON for a build step. The local SQLite mirror turns the corpus into something you can ask real questions of: which single set covers every icon this page needs, what breaks if you migrate from mdi to lucide, and which icons in this repo silently resolved through an alias.

quickstart.comment: confirm the API is reachable; no credentials are needed
mirror all 236 icon sets locally so search and analysis work offline
find an icon by describing it
fetch it as an SVG at your brand colour
pick one set that covers everything a page needs

troubleshoots.symptom: search returns far more results than the limit you asked for
troubleshoots.fix: The API silently clamps limit below 32. Run 'index' once and the analysis commands resolve locally, where the floor does not apply.

troubleshoots.symptom: an icon name comes back under a different name
troubleshoots.fix: Iconify resolves names through aliases, so lucide:home serves house. Run 'audit' to list every reference in a repo that resolved this way.

troubleshoots.symptom: set-pick, audit, swap, or diff report an empty index
troubleshoots.fix: They read the local mirror. Run 'index' first; it takes about 40 seconds for all 236 sets. If only some sets are missing, 'swap' withholds its verdict and names them under 'unindexed' — run 'index --only <prefix>' for those rather than trusting a partial answer.

troubleshoots.symptom: a set you rely on lost an icon after an upgrade
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'diff --set <prefix>' to list what upstream added or removed since your last index.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this when you need an icon and do not already know its exact name, when a project needs many icons rendered at one colour and size, or when you are deciding which icon set to standardise on. It is also the right tool for questions about icons already in a codebase: which sets are in play, whether their grid heights match, and whether any referenced name has been aliased away or removed upstream.
anti_triggers: Do not use this to design or draw a new icon; it only serves icons that already exist in Iconify's sets.
Do not use this to install a React or Vue component library; for framework components use the official @iconify packages.
Do not use this to convert an SVG into an icon set; that is what @iconify/tools does.

recipes.title: Find an icon when you only know what it looks like
recipes.command: iconify icons search --query "arrow that loops back" --limit 32 --agent --select icons
recipes.explanation: Search is fuzzy over names and set metadata, so describing the shape works better than guessing the exact name.

recipes.title: Render a brand-coloured icon straight to a file
recipes.explanation: Reads a manifest of icon names and writes one recoloured, uniformly sized SVG per entry, reporting any that were renamed upstream.

recipes.title: Choose one icon set for a whole page
recipes.command: iconify set-pick rocket shield handshake clock --agent
recipes.explanation: Ranks sets by how many of the listed concepts each covers, with licence and grid height, so you can commit to one set.

recipes.title: Cost out a migration before doing it
recipes.explanation: Classifies every icon as covered, renamed, or missing so you see the gaps before touching code.

recipes.title: Audit a repo's icon usage on review
recipes.explanation: Joins the repo's icon references against the local index to surface set sprawl and names that silently resolved through an alias.

trigger_phrases: what icon should I use for
which icon set should I use
migrate these icons to another set
audit the icons in this repo
